evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature implausibly high (~371→378 °C) and drifting monotonically upward with no plateau, inconsistent with overheads at ~52-69 °C and 300 mbar.
Reflux flow essentially zero/noisy (0.00-0.16 L/h) while distillate FT704 ~0.2-0.7 L/h, yet FYI702 reports ratio ~3.5-4.5, inconsistent with measured flows.
Column/condenser temperatures flat throughout, no separation front movement.

args.missing_evidence: Reboiler thermocouple cross-check (second TC or calibration), verification of reflux pump/flowmeter operation (FT703 vs FYI702 source), and a distillate composition (GC) sample.
